CONVEYOR SYSTEM PROBLEMS/CAUSES AND THEIR SOLUTIONS

symptom: Grooving, gouging or stripping of top cover.

causes.cause: Skirt boards improperly adjusted or of wrong material
actions: adjust skirt board supports to minimum 1" between metal and belt with gap increasing in direction of belt travel
use skirt board rubber (not old belt).
free idlers and improve maintenance and lubrication.

causes.cause: Material hanging up in or under chute

actions: reduce impact by improving chute design
install impact idlers or impact bed.

causes.cause: Sharp edges of material or tramp iron coming in contact with cover
actions: use jingle bars, impact idlers, and magnetic removal equipment.
